snippet.title: Meta Toy DragonZ SAGA Pre-Order
snippet.description:
▶Pre-Order: https://ntiny.link/mtdsaga3

How it Started:
Blocktown was torn apart by rogue wind-up toys, stealing every last treasure. Now, the Toy Dragons are fired up - it's time to rebuild, retaliate, and reclaim what's rightfully theirs.

Why You'll Love it:
▶ 300+ Unique Pixel-Style Toy Dragons
Build your number 1 expedition team from over 300 charming pixel dragons! Mix and match unique skills and attributes to create your dream Dragon squad and conquer various stages.

▶ Rebuilding Blocktown with Toy Dragons
Upgrade factories, rebuild stores, and bring Blocktown back to life! Every upgrade earns you rewards to boost your Toy Dragons and fuel your journey.

▶ Tons of Content & Endless Upgrades
Clear the changing wind-up factory dungeon daily to receive rewards and enhance your skills. Attack a massive fortress armed with numerous Toy Dragons and all kinds of weapons, and acquire passive skills as well.

▶ Discover New Combinations with Gem Blocks and Pets!
Combine various ability gem blocks and pets for unique strategic plays. Create your own custom combinations considering attributes and classes to strengthen your dragons even more.

▶ Master the Meta—Enjoy competitive PvP and PvE
Compete against other dragon expeditions in the arena to achieve thrilling victories and earn rewards. Build the most powerful army of Dragons suited for Boss Raid!
